prose: A Bloomberg analysis estimates a 1GW AI data center in Abilene, Texas could cost about $30B, including $17B on chips, $3B on power and $2.4B on construction, against roughly $750B of hyperscaler spending. The article is paywalled. Basis: the Techmeme headline and excerpt; the Bloomberg piece is paywalled.
